🎤 Public Speaking & Communication Practice

Published September 9, 2026 Kyambogo Student Hub

Comprehensive live test episodes for Public Speaking and Oral Communication are now live! Test your knowledge across 5 episodes covering fundamentals, speech preparation, non-verbal communication, meetings, and interviews.

The update

Five practice episodes are ready

  • Fundamentals of Public Speaking - 30 questions
  • Speech Preparation and Delivery - 50 questions
  • Non-Verbal Communication - 50 questions
  • Meetings and Interviews - 40 questions
  • Round-Up - 80 questions

Each episode includes theory, application, and scenario-based questions with instant feedback. The set is designed to support exam preparation at an international standard.
